thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to flip default API route to v2 in the Tue 03:00 UTC change window. Deploybot created a scheduled job.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: `route-default->v2` at 2026-03-24T03:00Z (ID 7990012345). Operator: @maria. To pause: `/deploybot hold 7990012345`.

kevin: ETA on release notes? I can push docs update but need final breaking change list.

maria: Kevin — I have a short summary, will paste in a sec. Important: streaming schema change for chat responses (minor) and header case normalization. No auth changes.

dave: Add a note about client SDKs that do strict header matching — mobile SDKs might need <=v1 compatibility flag.

sre_anne: Suggested rollback triggers: >2% 5m error rate for core routes OR median latency spike >200ms sustained 5m. Those are SLOs we can't violate.

ops_lead: Agree. Also watch for increased 429s from edge proxies. If observed, pause and revert route.

carol: Can we pin specific tenants during the flip? A few customers are still on older SDKs.

maria: Yes. We'll pre-populate a tenant-pinlist. Please add IDs to the list:
`/etc/deploy/tenant-pins.txt`

kevin: Adding: tenant_42, tenant_77, tenant_foo.

dave: I'm going to run a quick smoke in staging to validate header case fold.

deploy-bot: Hold placed on job 7990012345 by @dave at 2026-03-22T11:02Z. Use `/deploybot resume 7990012345` when ready.

maria: Thanks — resuming only after SRE thumbs-up and release note pushed. @sre_anne please Ack when monitors look good.

sre_anne: I'll run the synthetic probes, ETA 30m. If green, I'll say :thumbsup: and we resume.

carol: Also whispered — support doc update ready, will link in release notes soon.

maria: Perfect. Once we resume, deploybot will do a staged route-shift 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m gaps. Rollback automatically if any trigger fires.

kevin: Minor nit — can deploybot annotate the rollout with the release-note link? Makes postmortem easier.

deploy-bot: Update: job 7990012345 annotated with `https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2-route-notes`.

maria: OK team — syncing in 30. If anyone spots a client still sending `X-Api-Version: v1` we should pin them before resume.

sre_anne: Probes green. :thumbsup: recommend resume.

dave: I verified header behavior in staging.

maria: Resuming now. `/deploybot resume 7990012345`.

deploy-bot: Job 7990012345 resumed by @maria. Stage1 (10%) started. Will report after each stage.

kevin: Watching logs. :eyes:

carol: Support loop ready.

maria: Filing a short post-cutover checklist in confluence and will close this thread after 100%.

deploy-bot: Stage1 complete. Stage2 (50%) started.

dave: No anomalies so far.

deploy-bot: Rollout reached 100% — job complete. Default route now v2. If you see regressions, open #incidents and tag me.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the postmortem and customer comms.
